notes.title: Patch 2.3.0 released!
notes.content:
Latest patch for Immortal Empire offers the following features:

    Treant immortal has had many abilities altered, improved, including a replacement ultimate.
    You can now connect to gauntlet games in progress, making it possible to find replacement players or reconnect after a disconnection.
    Various minor bug fixes
    Currency adjustments for various regions to fit more in line with current values (prices generally cheaper in most regions)


Come check out the revamped Treant!

notes.title: Tournament of Champions -- July 30th!
notes.content:
Today is the Tournament of Champions!

If you have a level 200+ character, come join us for a 1v1 single elimination tournament in the Tower Control mode. Prizes are to be won!


Time: 1:00pm EDT 
Prizes: Runes and quite possibly something special for the winner ;)
How to join: Type "/join Tournament" in chat and receive further instructions. Please arrive 10 minutes early so we can assign matchups and get started promptly.


Game will be streamed and commentated on Twitch at http://www.twitch.tv/karma000

Happy Gaming,
Tactic Studios

notes.title: November 1v1 Tournament!
notes.content:
It's time for another official tournament where you can win powerful runes as prizes! Here are the details:


Date and Time: 1:00pm EST November 20th, 2016
Mode: 1v1 Tower Control, Single Elimination
Duration: Tournaments usually last 2-3 hours to reach the end of the finals match
Prizes: Multiple powerful runes will be awarded to the finalists, semi-finalists, and "Best Tactics" - a special prize for strong tactics prevailing against superior odds, typically awarded to lower level participants.
Characters: Any levels or immortal combinations allowed.
How to join: Login to Immortal Empire on Steam and join the tournament channel by typing "/join tournament" into chat. Please arrive 10 minutes early to receive your matchup.


Games will be streamed on Twitch at http://www.twitch.tv/karma000/. Come out and earn some runes!

notes.title: Gambling and Stash!
notes.content:
New version of Immortal Empire 2.2.0 is focused on improving the store. 

This update includes: 

You can now gamble gold for random divine and mythical items
You now have an account-wide stash for holding gold, crystals, and items
You can now buyback recently sold items to the store to prevent accidental sales
Level 51-60 radiance item packs are now cheaper
Radiance item purchases (including charms, runes) now only spawn items of divine or greater value.


Full patch notes can be found at our website

Note: If you bought any of the item, charm, or runes with radiance within the last 15 days, please contact gamesupport@tacticstudios.com with your immortal name and date of purchase (along with any real-money transaction information if relevant) and we will 100% refund your purchase.

notes.title: 3rd Official Tournament - 1v1 Deathmatch
notes.content:
1v1 Deathmatch Tournament on April 3rd!

It's time for another official tournament where you can win powerful runes as prizes! Here are the details:

Date and Time: 1:00pm EST April 3rd, 2016
Mode: 1v1 Deathmatch, Single Elimination
Duration: Tournaments usually last 2-3 hours to reach the end of the finals match
Prizes: Multiple powerful runes will be awarded to the finalists, semi-finalists, and "Best Tactics" - a special prize for strong tactics prevailing against superior odds, typically awarded to lower level participants.
Characters: Any levels or immortal combinations allowed, but level 150 or greater is recommended.
How to join: Login to Immortal Empire on Steam and join the tournament channel by typing "/join tournament" into chat. Please arrive 10 minutes early to receive your matchup.


Too low level to compete? No problem, we usually hold a few lower level matches and you can always spectate the high level games on Twitch.

Happy gaming,
Tactic Studios

notes.title: 2nd Official Tournament - Campaign Speedruns
notes.content:
2nd official tournament since we launched on Steam will be a set of campaign speedruns.  

Enjoy Immortal Empire, want to be competitive but don't fancy PvP? No problem! Play in a campaign speedrun. All players simultaneously try to clear a given campaign level and whoever finishes first wins!


Date and Time: 1:00pm EST February 21st, 2016
Characters: All immortals at any level are permitted. Higher level players will compete on higher difficulties, and there will be a prize for winners at each difficulty level attempted.
Duration: Speedrun tournaments usually last 1-2 hours with multiple speedruns to try.
Prizes: Runes will be awarded to the winners and runner ups of each speedrun.


Join chat channel "Tournament" using the command "/join tournament" when in public chat. Please arrive 10 minutes early to ensure you are ready to start the speedrun on time.

notes.title: Deathmatch and 4v4 is here!
notes.content:
Version 2.1.0 has a ton of improvements geared towards enhancing the PvP experience inside Immortal Empire.  

This update includes:

Deathmatch PvP mode including a new map
Up to 4v4 for tower control and deathmatch allowing primary immortals only
Loads of improvements for spectators to better observe PvP games.
A huge slew of balance changes to facilitate better PvP matches.
Various other bug fixes both large and small.


Full patch notes can be found at our website.

Come log on and check out the new deathmatch and 4v4 modes!
